a.xlink:title: Constructs a PrintingSelectorCardOverlayWidget for displaying a card overlay.
Emitted when the drawn artwork rect changes (size, scale factor, rotation, card).

Paints the widget, including both the card image and the text overlay.
Constructs a PrintingSelectorCardDisplayWidget to display card information.
Loads and displays all sets for the current selected card.

Constructs a PrintingSelector widget to display and manage card printings.
